record.issue_text: app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:15 — Unauthenticated GET with an arbitrary embed_url enqueues a RetrieveTopic job that makes an outbound fetch, allowing job-queue flooding and server-side request amplification

adjudication.rationale: EmbedController#best enqueues `:retrieve_topic` whenever no existing TopicEmbed is found (`Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)`), and there is no authentication check shown in this diff. The only gate is `ensure_embeddable`, which relies on `request.referer` matching `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`—a header that can be spoofed by non-browser clients—so it doesn’t reliably prevent unauthenticated callers. The job ultimately performs outbound network access via `open(url)` in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` and can also trigger `Jobs::PollFeed` which calls `open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates items. Throttling in `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` is per-URL (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`), so an attacker can flood the queue by varying embed_url (e.g., querystrings) and force repeated outbound fetch work.
